findings.replacement: 在这一构形中，规则一直偏向它所选中者，份额与规则都不低于起点，而对二者都不造成差别的损失可以越过任何界限；无噪声时，唯有它所读者的改变（一个在损失超过某界限时便不再偏向的读法，这是一条充分的出路，未表明是唯一的）
findings.why: In this edited row, 偏好 (twice) gives the rule preferences, which is excluded; blocks L and L-short say 偏向 / 有所偏向 for 'favouring'. 读取 is excluded, and here 'a reading' means the rule after a step as a function of the share, which the new 读 row renders as 读法. 所选中的东西 and 所读之物 are '…的东西' forms where 者 does the job. The English still says 'reads', so the 读 in 所读者 stays as the English keeps it.

findings.stands: 它是谁的损失、按哪一种比较来算，是意义所留为自由者。
findings.replacement: 它是谁的损失、按哪一种比较来算，由意义留为自由。
findings.why: 是意义所留为自由者 is a forced nominalisation and does not read naturally. 由意义留为自由 says 'is what significance leaves free' plainly and matches the page's own phrasing elsewhere (保持意义为自由, 意义保持自由).

findings.stands: 本论中心所说的两个关系，彼此分开。
findings.replacement: 本论的中心所说的两个关系，彼此分开。
findings.why: The same row ends with 本论的中心说的正是这种情形. Bare 本论中心 can be misread as a compound noun ('the account's centre point', or the 中心 (center) standpoint). Writing 本论的中心 both times keeps it one term.

findings.stands: 没有一个形成面对它被说成所读者。
findings.replacement: 说一个形成读什么时，这个形成并不面对所读者。
findings.why: 面对它被说成所读者 stacks a passive inside a relative clause, and the 它 has no clear referent, so the sentence is hard to parse. The replacement says the English 'No formation faces what it is said to read' in plain order and adds nothing.

findings.stands: 而从它所提高的份额读出时，它可以[锁定](theories/becoming/chapters/02-MAP.md#r-capture-through-the-rule)
findings.replacement: 而由它所提高的份额重新定出时，它可以[锁定](theories/becoming/chapters/02-MAP.md#r-capture-through-the-rule)
findings.why: This sentence states the lock's condition in the old wording (读出 from the share). The 锁定 row (line 58) and the 自己的 row (line 35) now say 由…份额重新定出, so the page says the same condition two ways. The English page has the same split at line 78 ('read from the share it raises it can lock'), so the English should change first and the Chinese follow it. I am raising it here for the coordinator; it is not a fault of this edit.

findings.stands: 它随集合而移动，整体没有以外。
findings.replacement: 它随集合而移动；整体无外。
findings.why: 整体没有以外 is unidiomatic, because 以外 needs a reference point. 整体无外 is the established form (至大无外), and it matches the 续无外 terms the page already uses for exactly this relation.

findings.stands: “从外部给定”说的是在模型以外，从不是在生灭变化以外
findings.replacement: “从外部给定”说的是在模型以外，决不是在生灭变化以外
findings.why: 从不 means 'never (on any occasion)' and goes with an action. A statement of sense takes 决不是 or 并不是. The meaning is unchanged: English 'never outside becoming'.
